title: Count herded worker sessions in bee report usage
action: Follow the Contract in docs/history/report-usage-herding/plan.md. bee report usage must add, for every .bee/mailbox/<job>/ under the control root whose job.json leader_session equals the leader transcript file stem and whose activity.json transcript_path exists, that transcript plus its subagents/*.jsonl, window-filtered, merged into the same per-model rows, each transcript path counted once. Skip non-matching or missing jobs silently. Add a herding-session count to text and --json output. Mirror how collect_herding_usage/herding_jobs in verbs/drivers/close.rs read activity.json, and resolve the control root the same way close does (a worktree reads the main checkout mailbox). Update the report usage help text in generated/registry_payload.json, the LEADER.md waggledance token rule (worker tokens: herded sessions are read through the job mailbox), and the claude-session-transport concept. Write tests first and watch them fail.

truths: A herded job whose leader_session matches adds its transcript tokens to the model row
A job of another leader, or with no leader_session, adds nothing
Events outside the window are excluded from herded transcripts too
A job whose transcript_path is missing is skipped without error
